notes: release: 1.25.0 Series now have an Episodes list in the player on phone, TV and desktop, with autoplay to the next episode and marking episodes watched right from the list. The side bar is simpler: Home, History, Favourites, Chats, Downloads and Settings, and Only my folders hides Telegram's own Chats and Saved groups. There is a shorter welcome tour, and Home says how to get a first video in. TMPlayer now asks before forgetting progress, clearing caches or deleting downloads. On desktop, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Bengali, Malayalam, Arabic and Persian show even without system fonts, and the AppImage updates only what changed. On TV, OK pauses in one press and See all sits on each Home row. Labels that were cut short in German, Russian and Malayalam fit, and buttons in the light theme are readable again.
